task.description: WF-03 Step 4b gate. Validate test/letflow/scripts/qa_fixture_service_task_endpoints_test.exs (TEST-DESIGNER handoff: step-04-test-designer.json) against the design section 6 and the defect (ISS-0930: seeded service-task endpoints were relative 'POST /path' strings). Verify: every design-specified assertion has a runnable test; no skipped/excluded tests; fixtures self-sufficient, no network; all 5 fixtures x all 25 nodes covered (count them independently). You MUST INDEPENDENTLY APPLY at least two mutants yourself (WF-03 doc: preferred technique is a THROWAWAY git worktree or temp copy, never mutating context.worktree; e.g. revert one fixture node endpoint to 'POST /x'; change one to http://; single-brace placeholder; remove the method) and run the test to see it fail - do not just accept reported counts (reported: 7/31 passed pre-fix; mutants fail 1-2 tests each). Also independently reproduce the pre-fix failure by running the new test against origin/main fixtures in a throwaway copy. Note the reported surviving mutant (hostname localhost passes with stub resolver) and judge whether it is an acceptable gap (UrlValidator has its own tests). Remove throwaways and verify `git status --porcelain lib/ test/ scripts/` in context.worktree is clean (new test is already committed). Also run `mix format --check-formatted` on the test file. Modify nothing but this handoff. Set IN_PROGRESS at claim, then COMPLETED/FAILED with result.status PASS/FAIL; next_action 'Route to TEST-RUNNER' on PASS. NOTE: the full `mix letflow.check.test` is heavy (16 partitions, exhausted Postgres connections in the previous step) - do NOT run it; TEST-RUNNER owns that.
acceptance_criteria: Every design assertion has a test
Two+ mutants independently applied and run

result.summary: Every design s6 assertion (1-7 plus static seed-script block) maps to a runnable test: TC-0930-01..09. No skip/exclude tags, no TODOs, no network (stub resolver), no DB, no hardcoded secrets, tests are independent, async-safe. Node count independently verified: 5 fixtures, 25 SERVICE_TASK nodes (7+6+3+3+6); the test is glob-driven with a per-fixture describe for each of the 5 and TC-01 guards against an empty glob.
result.pre_fix_reproduction: Throwaway copy with origin/main fixtures and scripts (helper removed): 'Result: 7/31 passed' (matches the reported count).
mutants_applied_by_validator: endpoint -> 'POST /x' (vortex assign-line): 29/31, TC-02 and TC-05 fail
https -> http:// (same node): 29/31, TC-02 and TC-05 fail
'not downgrading' removed from seed_vortex_definition.sh: 30/31, TC-08 fails
version_is_older renamed in helper: 30/31, TC-09 fails
result.baseline_in_copy: 31 passed before mutants and again after reverts.
result.surviving_mutant_judgement: host -> localhost (hostname) survives because the stub resolver returns a public IP. Acceptable: it is not the defect under test (ISS-0930 was missing scheme/host/method), real private-host resolution is covered by UrlValidator's own tests, and the stub is what keeps the test hermetic. Minor non-blocking note: a fixture pointing at a non-allowed hostname would only be caught in the live QA re-seed.
result.cleanliness: Throwaway copy removed. In context.worktree, git status --porcelain lib/ test/ scripts/ is empty (before and after); the test re-runs green: 'Result: 31 passed'. mix format --check-formatted on the test file: OK. Full mix letflow.check.test not run, per instruction.
